scripture.correctionNote: Migne prints Ezeeh. for Ezech. (broken c). The host sentence names Ezekiel outright and the four living creatures are Ezek. 1, so the reference is not in doubt.

heads.en: OF WHICH THESE ARE THE CHAPTERS.

heads.la: CAP. I.-- Quae Scripturae, etc. ut jam praemissum est.
heads.en: CHAP. I.-- Which writings, etc., as has already been set down above.

heads.la: CAP. II.-- Quod divina Scriptura ab aliis distinguitur in materia et modo tractandi.
heads.en: CHAP. II.-- That divine Scripture is distinguished from others in its matter and in its manner of treatment.

heads.la: CAP. III.-- De triplici intelligentia sacrae Scripturae.
heads.en: CHAP. III.-- On the threefold understanding of Holy Scripture.

heads.la: CAP. IV.-- Non omnia in divino eloquio comperta, sed quaedam duntaxat ad dictam triplicem interpretationem esse adigenda.
heads.en: CHAP. IV.-- That not all things found in the divine utterance, but only certain ones, are to be forced to the said threefold interpretation.

heads.la: CAP. V.-- Quod sit necessaria interpretatio litteralis et historica.
heads.en: CHAP. V.-- That the literal and historical interpretation is necessary.

heads.la: CAP. VI.-- De ordine, numero et auctoritate librorum sacrae Scripturae.
heads.en: CHAP. VI.-- On the order, number, and authority of the books of Holy Scripture.

heads.la: CAP. VII.-- De sacrorum librorum scriptoribus.
heads.en: CHAP. VII.-- On the writers of the sacred books.

heads.la: CAP. VIII.-- De bibliothecae Veteris Testamenti reparatione.
heads.en: CHAP. VIII.-- On the restoration of the library of the Old Testament.

heads.la: CAP. IX.-- De diversis Scripturae sacrae translationibus.
heads.en: CHAP. IX.-- On the various translations of Holy Scripture.

heads.la: CAP. X.-- De scriptoribus Novi Testamenti.
heads.en: CHAP. X.-- On the writers of the New Testament.
CHAP. XI.-- On the apocryphal writings.

heads.la: CAP. XII.-- De bibliothecae interpretatione, et variis librorum nominibus.
heads.en: CHAP. XII.-- On the interpretation of the word Library, and on the various names of books.

heads.la: CAP. XIII.-- De fructu divinae lectionis.
heads.en: CHAP. XIII.-- On the fruit of divine reading.

heads.la: CAP. XIV.-- Quem fructum sacra Scriptura ex aliis capiat, et quid aliis praestet; et de septem circumstantiis quibus res significatae discernuntur.
heads.en: CHAP. XIV.-- What fruit Holy Scripture takes from the others, and what it furnishes to others; and on the seven circumstances by which the things signified are discerned.

heads.la: CAP. XV.-- De numeris mysticis sacrae Scripturae.
heads.en: CHAP. XV.-- On the mystical numbers of Holy Scripture.

heads.la: CAP. XVI.-- De locis, temporibus, ac gestis mysticis sacrae Scripturae.
heads.en: CHAP. XVI.-- On the mystical places, times, and deeds of Holy Scripture.

heads.la: CAP. XVII.-- De materia sacrae Scripturae.
heads.en: CHAP. XVII.-- On the matter of Holy Scripture.

heads.la: CAP. XVIII.-- De difficultatibus sacrae Scripturae.
heads.en: CHAP. XVIII.-- On the difficulties of Holy Scripture.
